limitations.quote: End the match pulse and keep the ending 0
limitations.note: The patch correctly held `s3_d011` across invalid cycles but also changed two transitions out of `s4_d0110`, enabling overlapping matches where the reference returns to idle.
The exhaustive test used a sliding-window oracle that expected overlapping matches, so it confirmed the agent’s assumption instead of catching the change to the original post-match behavior.

limitations.quote: For an overlapping sequence detector, derive each transition from the longest suffix
limitations.note: The agent applied this advice to the full-match state without establishing that this task called for overlapping detections.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire test invocation to be rejected before simulation, so the agent had to repackage and resubmit it.
